name: bld6_cyclotomic_coeff_symm
statement: (n k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : k ≤ n.totient) : (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).coeff k = (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).coeff (n.totient - k)
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hk : k ≤ n.totient), (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).coeff k = (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).coeff (n.totient - k)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.poly_cyclotomic_reverse_eq_self: rewrite the left side with reverse Φ_n = Φ_n and apply Polynomial.coeff_reverse with natDegree Φ_n = φ(n) (Polynomial.natDegree_cyclotomic) and revAt φ(n) k = φ(n) - k for k ≤ φ(n).
type: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → k ≤ n.totient → (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).coeff k = (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).coeff (n.totient - k)
